claims.text: Nepal Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal stated that Nepal needs foreign technical assistance for specialized tasks such as tunnel rescue, body identification, DNA testing, and body storage.
A glacier collapse on Wednesday triggered flash floods that killed nearly 600 people across Nepal and Tibet, leaving over 2,400 missing.
Nepal's official death toll from the flash floods reached 579, while Chinese state media reported seven deaths in Tibet.
Chinese authorities evacuated 555 stranded tourists and 499 Chinese residents from Tibet following the floods.
At least 2,478 people were reported missing after the flood, including 1,924 in Nepal and 554 in Tibet.
More than 3,700 people have been rescued in Nepal, while at least 93,000 people have been affected by the calamity according to the Red Cross.
India sent 62 tonnes of emergency relief assistance to Nepal across three airlifts following the disaster.
Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke with Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah shortly after the disaster to offer humanitarian assistance.
The United Arab Emirates allocated $10 million in humanitarian aid to Nepal through the UAE Aid Agency.
Nepal Finance Minister Swarnim Wagle stated that Nepal will require at least a few billion dollars to recover from the flood destruction.
Indian External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar received 21 pilgrims from Tamil Nadu who were rescued from flood-affected areas in Nepal.
At least 320 Indian nationals remained uncontactable in Nepal following the flash floods.
Official sources stated that 149 Indian nationals crossed over from China into Nepal on August 28, 2026.
Karnataka Minister B. Nagendra submitted his resignation on Friday, 25 days after being re-inducted into the state cabinet.
Nagendra faces opposition allegations regarding the alleged misappropriation of ₹89 crore from the Karnataka Maharshi Valmiki Scheduled Tribes Development Corporation.
B. Nagendra requested permission from the Congress leadership to resign as an MLA in addition to stepping down from his cabinet position.
The financial irregularities in the Valmiki Corporation surfaced in May 2024 after an accounts superintendent died by suicide and left a note alleging unauthorized fund transfers.
Nagendra had previously resigned as tribal welfare minister in June 2024 before being re-inducted into the cabinet on August 3 after D.K. Shivakumar became Chief Minister.
Announcing his resignation, B. Nagendra stated: "Today I am voluntarily tendering my resignation as the minister."
Protests by opposition parties over Nagendra's cabinet return led to the Karnataka Legislature's monsoon session being adjourned sine die on August 24.
Police took BJP leaders B.Y. Vijayendra and R. Ashoka into preventive custody during a protest march toward the Vidhana Soudha in Bengaluru.
The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) filed a compliance affidavit with the Supreme Court proposing red hexagonal warning labels on the front of packaged foods.
The front-of-pack labelling case stems from a public interest litigation filed in the Supreme Court by the NGO 3S and Our Health Society.
Single-ingredient foods such as ghee, edible oil, salt, sugar, jaggery, and honey are proposed to be exempted from the front-of-pack warning requirement.

The proposed warning labels will display terms like 'High Fat', 'High Sugar', 'High Salt', or 'Highly Sweetened Beverage' in a font size one point larger than the nutrition table on the back of the package.
A Supreme Court bench headed by Justice J.B. Pardiwala issued an order on August 13 giving the government two weeks to submit its final decision on front-of-pack nutrition labelling.
A study published in The Lancet estimated that roughly 450 million people in India could be overweight or obese by 2050.
FSSAI proposed implementing the warning labels in two phases, starting with foods high in two or more specified nutrients before extending to foods high in any single specified nutrient.
The proposed labelling thresholds are based on the Dietary Guidelines for Indians 2024 issued by the ICMR-National Institute of Nutrition.
Senior Coca-Cola India executive Mili Bhattacharya stated during a March 19 meeting that it is "very simplistic" to believe seeing a symbol on a label will significantly improve a consumer's diet.
US Ambassador to India Sergio Gor announced that India plans to purchase the Javelin anti-tank guided missile system from the United States.
The Javelin is a man-portable anti-tank missile that uses fire-and-forget technology to track and hit targets automatically after launch.
The proposed sale of the Javelin anti-tank missile system to India is valued at $45.7 million.
US Ambassador Sergio Gor noted that US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth raised the possibility of joint co-production of the Javelin system at the May 2026 Shangri-La Dialogue.
In November 2025, the US State Department approved a potential $93 million sale to India involving up to 100 Javelin systems and 216 Excalibur artillery projectiles.
India requested to buy 100 FGM-148 Javelin rounds, one fly-to-buy missile, and 25 Javelin Command Launch Units.
India signed a Letter of Offer and Acceptance with the United States to purchase the Javelin anti-tank guided missile system through Foreign Military Sales.
The Javelin anti-tank missile system has been in full-rate production since 1994 and reached its 50,000th delivery in 2021.
